prereqs: Bachelor in EE/IT, automation or microelectronics (180 ECTS)
Control is one of the tracks, not a stated prerequisite
requirements.text: Bachelor in EE/IT, automation engineering, microelectronics or related; can apply with ≥140 ECTS if not finished. APS required for Indian degrees.
requirements.gpa: Applicant info PDF states German grade 2.0 or better — borderline for 7.67/10

add.notes: Summer-only intake, English-taught, ECE-friendly (microelectronics, microsystems). Flags: 2.0 grade minimum is a stretch and the deadline is 15 Oct 2026.

add.program: M.Sc. Research in Computer & Systems Engineering
add.deadlineNote: Foreign certificates: summer 2027 window 1 Aug – 15 Nov 2026; winter window about 16 Feb – 15 May.

prereqs: Bachelor in CS, technical CS, computer engineering or similar
Curriculum includes control theory (content, not a stated prerequisite)
requirements.text: Research-oriented programme covering complex embedded systems, control and communications with robotics/automotive applications. APS required for Indian degrees.
requirements.english: English proof required; score not published on the official page

add.notes: English-only, summer intake, no tuition; embedded + robotics + automation. Check that an ECE degree counts as a similar field and the exact English score.

add.program: M.Eng. Electrical Engineering and Embedded Systems
add.deadlineNote: Winter only; international window 1 Feb – 15 Apr (2027 dates inferred from the recurring pattern).

prereqs: Bachelor in EE, electronics, CS or related
requirements.text: Bachelor in EE/electronics/CS with German grade 2.5 or better and 210 ECTS. 3 semesters, 30 places. APS required for Indian degrees.
requirements.english: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 70 / B2, under 2 years old

add.notes: Direct ECE/embedded match, reachable grade cutoff, no control prerequisite. Winter intake only.

add.deadlineNote: universityadmissions.se round 1. Documents + SEK 900 fee by 1 Feb.

prereqs: 30 credits computer science incl. programming and computer architecture
requirements.text: Bachelor in engineering, maths or CS with 20 credits maths and 30 credits CS incl. programming and computer architecture. No control prerequisite.

add.notes: Pure embedded-systems programme with no control or mechanical prerequisites.

add.program: M.Sc. Electronics Engineering (Embedded Digital Systems / Microelectronics)
add.deadlineNote: universityadmissions.se round 1. Documents + SEK 900 fee by 1 Feb.

prereqs: 5 ECTS signals & systems / transforms / circuit theory
requirements.text: Bachelor in EE; choose Embedded digital systems (SoC) or Microelectronics (mixed-signal/RF IC) specialisation. No control prerequisite.

add.notes: Strong ECE match in IC/SoC design with an embedded digital systems track.

add.program: M.Sc. Information Technology (INFOTECH) – Embedded Systems Engineering / Computer HW-SW Engineering majors
add.deadlineNote: Apply 15 Nov 2026 – 15 Jan 2027 via C@MPUS. APS and English proof must be in hand before the deadline. Decisions around April–May.

tuition.note: Baden-Württemberg non-EU fee €1,500 per semester + ~€185 semester fee

requirements.text: Related B.Tech/BE with overall average above 70%, APS required for India, IELTS Academic 7.0
requirements.english: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 95 / PTE 76 / Cambridge C1

add.fit: Excellent ECE fit with an Embedded Systems Engineering major and no mechanical or control prerequisites.
add.notes: Majors: Embedded Systems Engineering, Computer HW/SW Engineering, Communication Engineering & Media Technology, Test & Reliability. Get APS before 15 Jan 2027.

add.deadlineNote: Programme page: summer semester 15 Jan, winter 15 Jul. International applicants may have earlier deadlines – confirm on FAU's international deadlines page.

tuition.note: New FAU non-EU fees from summer 2027: €2,000, €4,000 or €6,000 per semester depending on programme; this programme's tier not yet confirmed. Plus ~€82 semester contribution.

prereqs: Programme-specific content prerequisites not detailed – may include control/systems (FLAG)
requirements.text: Related bachelor, pass the online qualification test, English B2

add.fit: Robotics/autonomous systems with a summer intake; FLAG: Planning & Control track suggests some control background is expected.
add.notes: Specialisations: Human-System Interfaces, Networking & Collaboration, Planning & Control, Sensing & Perception.

add.program: Master's Programme in Intelligent Embedded Systems
add.deadlineNote: universityadmissions.se round 1 (assumed – MDU page still shows the 2026 start).

prereqs: 60 credits computer engineering/science incl. 15 credits programming
requirements.text: 180-credit bachelor with 60 cr CS/CE (incl. 15 cr programming) and 22.5 cr maths

add.fit: Strong embedded/AI fit, no mechanical or control prerequisites; check the ECE transcript shows ~60 credits of computing.
add.notes: Main risk is the 60-credit CS/CE requirement for an ECE degree.

add.program: Master's Programme in Electrical Engineering (embedded & sensor systems)
add.deadlineNote: universityadmissions.se round 1 (assumed; not yet on the Miun page). Only ~15 places.

tuition.note: Not shown on miun.se; third-party listings give ~SEK 144,000/yr – confirm

requirements.text: 180-credit bachelor in EE/electronics/CE/physics/maths + 22.5 cr maths + 15 cr EE

add.fit: Direct ECE fit (embedded and sensor systems), easy prerequisites, no mechanical or control requirement.
add.notes: Small cohort tied to the STC research centre.

add.deadlineNote: Programme page says 1 Dec – 1 Mar; TUHH's 2026 general guide said ~1 Feb, so aim for 1 Feb. Pre-check required before the full online application.

tuition.note: No tuition; ~€390 semester contribution incl. transit ticket

requirements.text: Engineering bachelor with 'very good' performance checked in a pre-check; APS for Indian degrees

add.fit: Good electronics/VLSI fit, no control prerequisites; FLAG: microsystems side has some electromechanical content.
add.notes: Free tuition; admission realism moderate because of the pre-check.

add.uni: Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da) – University of Applied Sciences
add.program: M.Sc. Electrical Engineering and Information Technology – International (MSE), majors: Embedded Systems & Microelectronics / Automation / Communications / Power
add.deadlineNote: International applicants apply 1 Dec – 31 Mar on the programme's own portal; winter intake only; decisions by 15 Apr. The page says that from 2027 Indian applicants need APS plus dMAT.

tuition.note: No tuition; semester fee €349. After admission, international students pay a €190 administrative fee, ~€840 enrolment fee and ~€1,300 accommodation fee.

prereqs: Bachelor in EE/IT or comparable, ≥180 ECTS, recognised in anabin
requirements.text: Admission board reviews the whole profile (no fixed GPA cut-off, 'excellent bachelor' expected); 2 recommendation letters, Europass CV and motivation letter required.
requirements.english: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (or TOEFL iBT 88); test under 2 years old

add.fit: Strong fit for ECE: English EE master with Embedded Systems & Microelectronics and Automation majors, no mechatronics prerequisite. Flags: winter intake only; 2 LORs; dMAT required for 2027.
add.notes: Optional preparatory courses in September and March. German helpful but not required.

add.deadlineNote: Non-EU deadline 1 May 2027 for the Sept 2027 start (Feb 2027 start closed 1 Oct 2026). Apply via Studielink, then UT's eligibility check.

requirements.text: CGPA ≥75% of maximum (70% for IIT/NIT). Motivation letter (max 2 pages), CV, course descriptions, English thesis summary.

add.fit: Core embedded-systems master with no mechatronics/control prerequisite. Flags: borderline 75% CGPA cut-off; OS, formal methods and computer architecture must show in the transcript; high tuition.
add.notes: Separate from the tracked Twente EE and Robotics programmes. Apply early for scholarship chances.

add.program: M.Sc. Electrical Engineering (tracks incl. Microelectronics, Signals & Systems, Wireless)
add.deadlineNote: Non-EU deadline 15 Jan (23:59 CET), ranked batch admission; date shown without a year, assumed for 2027/28. Non-EEA applications may be capped.

prereqs: Engineering BSc in EE or closely related
Signals & systems (signal processing, systems and control)
requirements.text: India: 4-year bachelor with CGPA ≥75%; ranked on key-subject grades.

add.fit: Good ECE subject match (microelectronics/embedded-oriented tracks, no mechatronics prerequisite). Flags: very competitive ranked admission with 7.67/10 near the cut-off; 'systems and control' among key subjects; high tuition.
add.notes: Separate from tracked TU Delft CESE and Robotics. €100 fee not confirmed on the pages checked.

add.program: M.Sc. Electrical Engineering and Information Technology (Electronic & Communication Systems or Automation focus)
add.deadlineNote: Summer 2027: 15 Oct – 1 Dec 2026; winter 2027: 15 Apr – 15 Jun 2027, via Primuss. Written aptitude test. THD apply page says Indian master's applicants need dMAT proof from SS2027 (15 Sep 2026 deadline), so summer 2027 may be out – aim for winter 2027 if dMAT/APS not started.

tuition.note: No tuition; €500 non-EU service fee per semester + ~€82 student union fee

prereqs: Bachelor in EE and/or CS or related, ≥210 ECTS
German A2 certificate mandatory at application
requirements.text: Overall grade 'good' (German 2.5 or better), ≥210 ECTS, aptitude test, German A2 at application. 3 semesters.
requirements.english: Taught in English; no IELTS score stated on the programme page

add.fit: Only new option with a summer (March) intake: English EE/IT master with electronics or automation focus, no mechatronics prerequisite. Flags: German A2 mandatory; dMAT timing for summer 2027 may have passed; borderline grade; aptitude test.

add.deadlineNote: Non-EU applicants needing a residence permit apply via universityadmissions.se round 1 (16 Oct 2026 – 15 Jan 2027). JU Direct Application to 2 May 2027 is too late for a permit.

prereqs: Bachelor 180 ECTS with ≥90 credits in computer engineering, CS or electrical engineering
requirements.text: ECE B.Tech qualifies through EE credits; no GPA cut-off.
requirements.english: English 6 (IELTS 6.5, no band below 5.5) – Swedish standard, not stated on the page

add.fit: Easy admission for ECE (no GPA cut-off, no control prerequisite) with confirmed 2027 dates. Flag: pure AI/ML curriculum, no embedded or robotics courses – a safety option.
add.notes: JU has no dedicated embedded/electrical master for 2027.
